events.verdict: Post (GSW) establishes himself in Gillespie's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Post (GSW) maintains verticality as he defends Gillespie's (PHX) shot attempt.
Ighodaro (PHX) is moving alongside Butler III's (GSW) path before they come together during the drive.
Brooks (PHX) directly contests Podziemski's (GSW) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Podziemski's (GSW) hand after the release.
Payton II (GSW) establishes himself in Goodwin's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Ighodaro (PHX) initiates more than marginal contact to Butler III (GSW) during his shot attempt near the rim.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact with Booker (PHX). When he swipes down, he avoids making contact to Booker's arm.
Brooks (PHX) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Podziemski (GSW) legally contests Gillespie's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) initiates illegal contact to Curry's (GSW) arm as he receives the throw-in.
Gillespie's (PHX) pass goes off of O'Neale's (PHX) hands and into the backcout, where Booker (PHX) illegally retrieves it.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
